cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check what commit we pulled - fetch from git
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git log --oneline -5")
print("Commits:", stdout.read().decode())
# Reset to origin/main instead
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git stash && git checkout main && git pull origin main 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("\nSwitched to main:", stdout.read().decode())
# Restart
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria 2>&1 | tail -5")
print("\nRestarted:", stdout.read().decode())
import time
time.sleep(8)
# Check port
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep 3000")
print("\nPort 3000:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
